Convoyed by the spearmen, the party of Leoncia, the two Morgans, and Torres, was led through the pleasant fields, all under a high state of primitive cultivation, and on across running streams and through woodland stretches and knee deep pastures where grazed cows of so miniature a breed that, full-grown, they were no larger than young calves.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0002", "tag": "p", "text": "“They’re milch cows without mistake,” Henry commented. “And they’re perfect beauties. But did you ever see such dwarfs! “Don’t fool yourself,” Francis spoke up. “Take that one over there, the black one. I’ll wager it’s not an ounce under three hundredweight.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0004", "tag": "p", "text": "“How much will you wager?” Henry challenged.", "sha256": "59eb6bb4a9c43a753e236f62782a844e749cfe49806625b3e5dea2c0cab47760", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1645]", "source_html": "

“How much will you wager?” Henry challenged.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0005", "tag": "p", "text": "“Name the bet,” was the reply.", "sha256": "9e68de6ffab4d13373835ad27d2fe2e9292c9fb1d48e0e5fd324f99878918be3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1646]", "source_html": "

“Name the bet,” was the reply.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0006", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then a hundred even,” Henry stated, “that I can lift it up and walk away with it.”", "sha256": "bf4be0b4ac54421fb47f834b230c46f8faf4732563377db6d3a5bf76784e150c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1647]", "source_html": "

“Then a hundred even,” Henry stated, “that I can lift it up and walk away with it.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“Done.”", "sha256": "cd56a5385e557efc9b31f5b9f052018ba9cbd0d6c3b92da11f95d219afe6432b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1648]", "source_html": "

“Done.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0008", "tag": "p", "text": "But the bet was never to be decided, for the instant Henry left the path he was poked back by the spearmen, who scowled and made signs that they were to proceed straight ahead.", "sha256": "ec501e5b330cf104dda321f6f0b8927a511d06dc3850b2f9f6be64f886d8bbb7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1649]", "source_html": "

But the bet was never to be decided, for the instant Henry left the path he was poked back by the spearmen, who scowled and made signs that they were to proceed straight ahead.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0009", "tag": "p", "text": "Where the way came to lead past the foot of a very rugged cliff, they saw above them many goats.", "sha256": "a992c4a83a5d4539df1f81ae37e126cf7339b0e00f765e9469c99b76e5fd99f1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1650]", "source_html": "

Where the way came to lead past the foot of a very rugged cliff, they saw above them many goats.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0010", "tag": "p", "text": "“Domesticated,” said Francis. “Look at the herd boys.”", "sha256": "259930cfc0f0b11864908228e39b289f34bea522e22ae75b4e8fc57d8996991f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1651]", "source_html": "

“Domesticated,” said Francis. “Look at the herd boys.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0011", "tag": "p", "text": "“I was sure it was goat-meat in that stew,” Henry nodded. “I always did like goats. If the Lady Who Dreams, whoever she may be, vetoes the priest and lets us live, and if we have to stay with the Lost Souls for the rest of our days, I’m going to petition to be made master goatherd of the realm, and I’ll build you a nice little cottage, Leoncia, and you can become the Exalted Cheese-maker to the Queen.”", "sha256": "799b691c094466c6331f38ba9660820fdc716d4162d2d150c26f76c20951b6c3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1652]", "source_html": "

“I was sure it was goat-meat in that stew,” Henry nodded. “I always did like goats. If the Lady Who Dreams, whoever she may be, vetoes the priest and lets us live, and if we have to stay with the Lost Souls for the rest of our days, I’m going to petition to be made master goatherd of the realm, and I’ll build you a nice little cottage, Leoncia, and you can become the Exalted Cheese-maker to the Queen.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0012", "tag": "p", "text": "But he did not whimsically wander farther, for, at that moment, they emerged upon a lake so beautiful as to bring a long whistle from Francis, a hand-clap from Leoncia, and a muttered ejaculation of appreciation from Torres. Fully a mile in length it stretched, with more than half the same in width, and was a perfect oval. With one exception, no habitation broke the fringe of trees, bamboo thickets, and rushes that circled its shore, even along the foot of the cliff where the bamboo was exceptionally luxuriant. On the placid surface was so vividly mirrored the surrounding mountains that the eye could scarcely discern where reality ended and reflection began.", "sha256": "17fde624477f13012346a1225bffd532082b4a34e7cf8758d9ab182c07f042a6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1653]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0014", "tag": "p", "text": "“What a pity it is so muddy!”", "sha256": "7051cac619438c3d210f1f2dcb9f7c60191d3496ba0a51f9d778019f587c7a1a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1655]", "source_html": "

“What a pity it is so muddy!”
